title.narrative: Increasing food production and livehood improvement in the Kamiranzovu marshland area, Burera District, Rwanda

description.narrative:
Description

The global objective of this action is to strengthen food security and nutrition in Rwanda.

The proposed action intends to boost food production in the Kamiranzovu marshland area by (i) increasing food production and reducing vulnerability to dry seasons and climate change linked drought spells through solar powered irrigation and sustainable land husbandry practices; (ii) reducing losses from inadequate postharvest practices through increased access to produce drying and storing facilities; (iii) reducing malnutrition through promotion of small livestock and kitchen gardens especially in vulnerable households; and (iv)increasing skills, awareness and technical know-how transfer to local farmers
